name: Soil Science
summary: How soils form, what they are made of, and how their physical, chemical and biological properties support ecosystems and agriculture.

topics.name: Soil-forming factors: parent material, climate, organisms, topography and time
Soil physical properties: texture, structure, density and porosity
Soil water: retention, movement and plant availability
Clay minerals, cation exchange capacity and soil colloids
Soil organic matter and soil carbon
Soil biology: microbes, fauna and nutrient cycling
Soil classification: USDA Soil Taxonomy and the World Reference Base
Soil survey and mapping; the critical zone concept
